items.summary: Approve only three isolated, preview-only implementation reviews for complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net, routed to engineer. No publication, deployment, telemetry activation, monetization, spend, credential/configuration changes, dependency additions, or production claims are authorized. Acceptance requires deterministic build, link, accessibility, metadata, and preview-smoke checks; a dated readiness artifact; measurable preview quality-gate results; and an isolated rollback commit. Production remains blocked because launch-readiness, compliance, analytics, operations, and security evidence are incomplete. Site-factory owns the readiness artifacts by 2026-10-03T17:00Z; unresolved blockers escalate to the owner.
